dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: This isn't a place to be wandering about. If you don't have any business here, get out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Geode Mine Shaft...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: *yawn* Sorry, I'm a bit tired. I think it's because of the stones... Have you ever heard anyone talk about how they have a mysterious energy?

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: I don't know what the Fontaine Research Institute engineers do with the stones. But they form here, looking like that. Just thinking about them makes me sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: If... If you can avoid it, don't go over there. Otherwise I'll need to write a report... *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the middle gearwheel...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Oh, that... That's, uh, an old issue from way back when.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Just don't go touching it. I don't want my whole world to start spinning while I'm enjoying a proper snooze...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Heh. I just mean, if you do move it make sure you don't accidentally trap anyone. It's happened before.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Not that creatures like humans will ever learn from their mistakes, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Good night... Uh, I mean goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you! *cough* This isn't a place to be wandering about. If you don't have any business here, get out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Geode Mine Shaft...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Clynes's device isn't as useful as he claims it is... But there are four of you.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: In that case, it would be best if I knew nothing about any of this. In fact, it must be something I dream up while sleeping in my lovely soft bed.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: *cough* Estienne wrote the incident report. I don't know what happened. I just found a new place to take a beautiful nap.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the middle gearwheel...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Oh, that... That's, uh, an old issue from way back when.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Just don't go touching it again, please. I don't want my whole world to start spinning while I'm enjoying a proper snooze...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: And if something does go wrong I can't act like I didn't see anything this time. I mean, I'm right here.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: And if say I didn't see anything, that would prove I've been sleeping on the job. I hope you can understand.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Such exciting duels don't come knocking too often round these parts. I'm not feeling so sleepy anymore, thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: *yawn* Lost, as expected. Now I'm even sleepier...
